d: Short, ash blonde hair with a messy texture is partially covered by a grey fedora with a black band and a white feather. The eyes are a piercing yellow-gold with a sharp, calculating expression on a face reflecting a mature adult appearance. This slender build is dressed in a dark grey mini-skirt with a high slit and lace-up detailing, a black collared shirt, and an oversized, bright red jacket draped over the shoulders. Accessories include black leather gloves, black thigh-high stockings with a buckle strap, black high-heeled pumps, and a black folder held in the hand.
